submitted.rationale: XRD showed monoclinic BiVO4 (strong peak at Q≈2.035 Å⁻¹) across the low-Cu region. I followed the Bi-rich, low-Cu direction: 286 (Bi 0.43) gave 1.0e-7 A, 161 (Bi 0.47) gave 1.6e-7 A, and 122 (Bi 0.55, Cu 0.20, V 0.26) gave 7.6e-7 A, the highest measured.

rejected.reason: XRD showed extra peaks that may be a Cu-vanadate phase at higher V; composition moves away from the Bi-rich trend
